exact_claim_text: In this illustrative purposive corpus, participants described uncertainty as a negotiated judgement across tool behaviour, data plausibility and self-assessment, with at least one account resisting the dominant pattern of initial tool trust.
method_or_source: Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.
uncertainty: Researcher interpretation, sample composition, incomplete recall, social desirability and transfer beyond the teaching context.
boundary: Illustrative purposive sample of 12 novice analysts in one teaching context; no statistical prevalence claim and no case-study claim.
counter_evidence: Illustrative synthesis only: the worked material develops a theme of “oscillating trust”, in which participants alternate between trusting the computational tool and interrogating the data or their own code. One negative case describes immediate distrust of automated output.
stronger_wording_rejected: Novice analysts generally trust automated notebook outputs.
